paragraphs: DacraTech sells back-office software for municipal enforcement, covering automated photo enforcement, electronic citations and adjudication. Its customers are counties, cities, towns and villages that have implemented the software. One part of the suite covers adjudication and municipal court.

Agencies can take the full suite or pick individual modules based on what the community needs. Open APIs connect it to police RMS, CAD and city ERP systems so citation information is populated automatically. Automation runs from issuance to court and through collections. Role-based security management determines which staff see which information.

The about page says each member of the leadership group has decades of experience in municipal software and in fields such as law and law enforcement, e-commerce and data analytics. The company states that it has onboarded hundreds of clients. A testimonial on the homepage is attributed to a chief of police in Middletown, CT.

quote.text: Our goal is to build safer communities and more efficient government.
